column1: # Guild no-touch roster — accounts kami-zero MUST NOT liquidate.
# Source: founder copy/paste from Guild website (kamibots API has no roster
#         endpoint as of 2026-05-01; flagged to Coopes).
# Refresh: every 7 days; if updated_at older than that
# account_id is blank on initial paste — kami-zero resolves handles to on-chain
# account/operator IDs in session 71 (sub-priority under P3) and writes the
# resolved IDs back so the no-liquidate gate can match by ID. Until an entry
# has a non-empty account_id it should still match by handle as a fallback.
# note column: "FOUNDER_OWN" marks accounts the founder owns (sanity-check
# entries — should never be a target anyway). Other entries are guild allies.
